description: KuCoin's public API for USDT perpetual futures: daily (or 1h/4h) candles and every funding settlement, back to the year you pick, then kept current every 6 hours. No keys. KuCoin has no archive, so each closed month and day is paged from the API and written once as a gzipped CSV, with what it covered in a manifest. Files go to the lake under raw/kucoin/futures/<instance>. KuCoin's funding is not Binance's (often much higher): research for a KuCoin position should read this.

symbols.description: KuCoin's contract names: XBTUSDTM is BTC, then ETHUSDTM, SOLUSDTM, ...

intervals.title: Candle intervals
intervals.description: KuCoin keeps daily candles back to listing; its hourly history is short (none for 2021), so older 1h and 4h months stay empty.

start_year.title: From the start of
start_year.description: KuCoin's USDT perpetuals start in 2020 (XBTUSDTM in March); months before a contract listed are skipped.
